record.dic_text:
03594 Kiyuwn {kee-yoon'}

源自 03559; 專有名詞 神祇名

欽定本 - Chiun 1; 1

龕 = "神像" 或 "柱石"
1) 可能是亞述-巴比倫的土星神雕像 (#摩 5:26|)
record.edic_text:
03594 Kiyuwn {kee-yoon'}

from 03559;; n pr dei

AV - Chiun 1; 1

Chiun = "an image" or "pillar"
1) probably a statue of the Assyrian-Babylonian god of the planet
   Saturn and used to symbolise Israelite apostasy
